marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northeast 20 knots late overnight and
to northwest 30 late Wednesday morning. Rain beginning overnight becoming snow or rain Wednesday
afternoon. Fog patches forming this evening and dissipating early Wednesday
morning. Visibility 1 mile or less in fog patches and as low as 1 mile in
precipitation. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early Wednesday
morning.<br/>
